title: Free Lae'zel
html:
Free Lae'zel is a quest on the Ravaged Beach in Act One of Baldur's Gate 3. It is initiated by locating  Lae'zel, who is being held in a cage by a pair of Tiefling scouts,  Nymessa and  Damays.

Objectives

Objectives and journal entries may vary pending player decisions and outcomes.

Resolve the conflict.
  • We found Lae'zel, the githyanki from the nautiloid, trapped in a hanging cage. Two tieflings are deciding what to do with her.
  • We entered Lae'zel's mind.
  • Lae'zel said she knew of a cure for the parasite. We won't find out what it is unless we help her get rid of the tieflings.
Free Lae'zel.
  • The tieflings refuse to leave. We need a new plan.
  • We convinced the tieflings to leave Lae'zel with us.
  • We convinced the tiefling to leave Lae'zel where she was.
  • We defeated the tiefling scouts, but Lae'zel remains caged.
  • The tieflings have been dealt with. Lae'zel demanded that we release her from her cage.
Defeat the tieflings.
  • The tieflings refused to walk away and attacked us.
  • After Lae'zel was released, we sided with her against the tieflings.
  • We released Lae'zel from her cage, and the tieflings attacked us.
  • We attacked the tieflings.
Speak with Lae'zel.
  • We convinced the tieflings to walk away.
Recruit Lae'zel.
  • Lae'zel has been released from the cage. We should speak with her.
Wait for the tieflings to open the cage.
  • We convinced the tieflings to help us kill Lae'zel.
Open the cage.
  • We convinced the tiefling that Lae'zel should be killed.
Kill Lae'zel.
  • After Lae'zel was released, we sided with the tieflings against her.
  • We remained neutral when Lae'zel asked us for help, and she attacked us.
Quest Complete
  • Lae'zel has joined the party.
  • We invited Lae'zel to our camp.
  • After Lae'zel was released, we didn't invite her to join our party.
  • We defeated Lae'zel.
  • Lae'zel is dead.
  • We left Lae'zel to her fate.

Walkthrough

After the Nautiloid crash, Lae'zel cannot be found on the beach. When the player character regains consciousness, they can inform  Shadowheart that they intend to search for her. Lae'zel can be found in a cage north of the Roadside Cliffs waypoint at X: 224 Y: 372.  Nymessa and  Damays refuse to free her because they view her as a threat. The party can convince the Tieflings to shoot Lae'zel's cage down, attempt to speak with her civilly, or leave this matter entirely to the party. DC checks are dependent on whether one or both Tieflings are present, with easier checks against the lone Tiefling.

[1]
  • [DECEPTION] This creature is dangerous. Get out of here - leave it to me! (DC 10) (non-Paladin only)
  • [PALADIN] [DECEPTION] Your quarry looks dangerous, but I've handled worse. Leave it to me, get to safety. (DC 10)
  • [BARBARIAN] [PERSUASION] Shoot the trap down. I'll tear it apart before anyone else gets hurt. (DC 5) (non-Shadowheart only)
  • [PERSUASION] Shoot the trap down. We must kill it before it harms someone. (DC 5) (non-Barbarian, non-Shadowheart only)
  • [BARD] [DECEPTION] Oh, gods! You've caught a scout; the gith invasion force is right behind me - save yourself! (DC 10)
  • [MONK] [PERSUASION] The githyanki's an intelligent creature, just like you. Release her, and let us converse civilly. (DC 7)
  • [PERSUASION] She's an intelligent creature, not a beast to be trapped. Cut her down, and converse with her. (DC 7)[note 1]

If the party member who interacts with the scouts is a Drow, Half-Drow, Duergar, or Githyanki, the Tieflings turn hostile immediately unless an  DC 5 Intimidation Check is passed.

If the Tieflings shoot the trap down, the party must choose to side with Lae'zel or the Tieflings.

If deceiving the Tieflings into leaving Lae'zel to them, the Tieflings exit the area. Lae'zel can then drop safely out of the cage by destroying the cage floor with any ranged attack. Attacking the cage while the Tieflings are still in view causes them to turn hostile. Killing the tieflings after convincing them to free Lae'zel grants the ⁠Flexible Diplomacy inspiration to party members with the  Charlatan background.

Once Lae'zel is released, she can leave or be recruited as a party member. If she joins the party, ⁠The Githyanki Warrior is added to the Quest log.

If Lae'zel is attacked and knocked out, she then appears during the encounter with Kith'rack  Voss at the Mountain Pass as normal. If she is looted she then wears a  Hide Armour together with a  Goblin Scimitar.

Notes

  1. ↑ This option is only available if Nymessa is missing/unavailable for the dialogue
  1. ↑ Dialogue file: Act1/Chapel/CHA_LaeZelRecruitment_TieflingsScene

Bugs

  • When loading a game saved after Lae'zel is released, the cage floor may reappear in its original position, hovering in midair and impossible to interact with. This does not have any impact on the quest.
  • If sending Lae'zel to camp after saving her, there's a chance, that she fights the temple bandits alone and dies. This can result in being unable to talk to her anymore. Her death will not solve this issue.[verify]

Quest rewards

  • Lae'zel as a Companion.
